case_title.quote: JO OHAN v. STATE OF M.P.

number_of_accused.quote: Except the present appellant, the other accused persons have not preferred any appeal.
number_of_accused.reason: Only one appellant, Jodhan, is before the Court.

accused_gender.quote: Jodhan, the present appellant, caused injury in the right leg of Heeralal
accused_gender.reason: Appellant referred to as 'he'; male is supported.

accused_caste.reason: Caste not stated; 'Kumharwalas' is a reference to victims' party, not clearly caste.

victim_gender.quote: Kanchhedi assaulted Rukmanibai on her left hand with farsa
victim_gender.reason: Deceased is male, but injured victims include women (Rukmanibai, Rambai), so Mixed fits better.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused persons and the informant were in inimical terms due to non-voting by the informant's party in their favour
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Prior enmity over non-voting is noted as described.

offence_category.quote: convicted under Section 302 in aid of Section 149

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302, 323, 324 read with Sections 149 ... and 148 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Charges match; ESA ss.3 and 4 charged against appellant.

weapon.correct_value: Lathis, farsa and handmade bombs; the deceased was killed by a handmade bomb thrown by co-accused Mangal Singh; appellant threw a bomb at Heeralal
weapon.quote: Mangal Singh threw a handmade bomb on the chest of Siriya
weapon.reason: Substance correct. 'Axe-like weapon' gloss for farsa is not in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: their evidence also find support from the medical evidence and the initial allegations made in the FIR
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery and FIR all supported.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the accused persons armed with lethal weapons had gone to the house of deceased

trial_court_outcome.quote: disbelieved the story of the prosecution and acquitted all the accused persons

high_court_outcome.quote: sentence each of the accused under Section 302 read with Section 149 of IPC and imposed rigorous imprisonment for life
high_court_outcome.reason: Accurate summary of High Court's decision.

final_outcome.quote: the appeal, being devoid of any merit, has to pave the path of dismissal

offence_finally_established.quote: deserved to be convicted under Section 302 in aid of Section 149

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove 'victim... declared brought dead' fine, but drop the final sentence about the accused's plea only if needed; also avoid 'a group of men' implying gender.
neutral_facts.quote: the accused persons, namely, Mangal Singh, Babbu, Jodhan, Kanchhedi ... came there armed with lathis, farsa and handmade bombs
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly accurate, but 'group of men' reveals gender of the accused, which the instructions forbid.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: Siriya @ Shriram had already succumbed to the injuries

physical_harm.quote: the deceased died due to extensive haemorrhage, shock and lung compression

number_of_offences.correct_value: 7 charged (ss.302, 323, 324, 149, 148 IPC; ss.3 and 4 Explosive Substances Act); 1 upheld
number_of_offences.quote: charges under Sections 302, 323, 324 read with Sections 149 and 148 of IPC ... Sections 3 and 4 of Explosive Substances Act
number_of_offences.reason: Counting ss.302, 323, 324, 148, 3, 4 gives six, matching; though s.149 is arguably separate. The count is defensible; the upheld part is fine.

premeditation_planning.quote: with pre-determined mind threw the bomb on the chest of the deceased

motive.quote: it is Mangal who threw the bomb on the chest of the deceased only because he had objected to the hurling of abuses

key_evidence_accepted.quote: Ratta, PW-7, Rukmanibai, PW-14, Rambai, PW-15 and Heeralal, PW-16

witness_credibility.quote: they have lent support to each other's version in all material particulars

post_offence_conduct.reason: No absconding or similar conduct noted.

trial_duration.reason: Dates correct; trial date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Varinder Kumar Sharma, Vipin Kumar, K. K. Shrivastava (for Deepak Goel) for the Appellant. C. D. Singh for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: placed the chargesheet in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Vidisha

appeal_history.quote: the High Court is justified in reversing the judgment of acquittal

prosecution_argument.quote: when the accused persons formed an unlawful assembly, Section 149 gets squarely attracted

defence_argument.quote: when the appellant had not caused any injury on the deceased, he should not have been convicted under Section 302 IPC

legal_principle_applied.quote: it would not be correct to say that before a person is held to be a member of an unlawful assembly, it must be shown that he had committed some illegal overt act

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Dalip Singh v. State of Punjab AIR 1953 SC 364

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court did not weigh aggravating factors for sentencing; these were merits findings.
